svg.title: Golden Wattle Sprig — fringed puff heads
svg.desc: Sprig 300 mm · puff heads 40 mm and 30 mm. Fringe each scalloped disc toward the centre with fine scissors, dome it over a fingertip and tack the rim. Gather three or four heads at each stem tip in loose clusters, then tape the slim phyllode leaves down the stem in pairs.
